title: Jehoiakim's Rebellion and Jehoiachin's Exile
description: The chapter tells of King Jehoiakim's rebellion against Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, his death, and the succession of his son Jehoiachin. Nebuchadnezzar besieges Jerusalem, and King Jehoiachin surrenders. The king of Babylon carries away the temple treasures, cuts up the gold vessels that Solomon had made, and exiles Jehoiachin along with the royal family, nobles, warriors, and craftsmen to Babylon. He installs Mattaniah, Jehoiakim's uncle, as king and gives him the name Zedekiah.
